image_reading: A sunlit landscaped courtyard frames the entrance of a tall brick residential building.
A woman is already walking out from the central entrance along the paved path; trees and ornamental grasses can move subtly in a light breeze.
The composition keeps the building facade and welcoming pedestrian courtyard clearly visible.
analysis.article_context: Cover image for an expert guide on whether to take a mortgage in late 2026; it presents a modern, comfortable new-build residence as a tangible near-term home-buying opportunity.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A comfortable contemporary residential complex is presented as a real, welcoming home-buying opportunity for readers considering a mortgage.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman walks away from the building entrance along the courtyard path.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The woman is visibly farther along the sunlit paved walkway while the entrance and residential courtyard remain clearly recognizable.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The residential setting remains calm, welcoming, and recognizably aspirational as a place to live.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the woman continues her natural forward walk from the entrance toward the open paved courtyard. A restrained forward camera drift follows her as the focal target while keeping the facade and doorway readable. Leaves and planting respond with a mild breeze throughout. By the final frames she is visibly farther from the doorway on the path, with the calm, inviting residential setting unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: The woman walks steadily away from the entrance along the sunlit path as leaves and grasses stir lightly; a slow forward camera drift keeps the entrance and her in view, ending with her clearly farther along the walkway in the welcoming residential courtyard.

models.scene_plan: For the five-second shot, let the exiting woman carry one continuous walking action from the doorway toward the courtyard. Use a small, smooth forward move motivated by following her progress, without shifting attention away from the residential facade. Gentle wind moves the visible greenery. Her position advances steadily until she reaches a clearly more open section of the walkway near the end, preserving the scene's composed, welcoming feel.
models.positive_prompt: The woman continues walking from the entrance into the courtyard at an even pace. A subtle forward camera move follows her; nearby leaves and flowering grasses sway gently. End with her farther along the paved path, the modern home entrance still clearly visible.

models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, focus on the woman’s existing walk as she moves away from the entrance at a moderate, unhurried pace. A single gentle forward drift tracks her progression and retains the entrance as contextual proof of the new-build home. Environmental motion stays limited to a light breeze in the visible foliage. In the last moment, she is unmistakably farther down the path, with the courtyard still calm and inviting.
models.positive_prompt: The woman walks smoothly away from the building entrance along the paved courtyard path while tree leaves and grasses move in a light breeze. Use a gentle forward camera drift focused on her, ending with her distinctly farther down the sunlit walkway and the entrance still in frame.
